exact_statement: For the fixed-scale formal queue label component C_lab=sum_{A nonempty} fhat(A)^2 min_tau |F_tau(A)| log2 k at lambda=1/k: odd majority n=2a+1,t=a+1 in its prime DNF has E min|F|=1+T_n, k=binom(n-1,t-1), I=n*binom(n-1,t-1)/2^(n-1), T_n=P(|S|>t), so C_lab/I~sqrt(pi*n/2); every exact DNF of majority has read at least this k and formal C_lab>=log2 k. Its minimum allocation pressure among minimum-count assignments is zero except |A|=n, with mean W_n*(t-1)*log2(t/(t-1)) (zero for n=1). Disjoint tribes w,s with z=2^-w,q=1-(1-z)^s has prime k=1,C_lab=0,allocation=0,E|F|=4*s*z*(1-z)^s,I=2*s*w*z*(1-z)^(s-1); full-cell C_lab=4*q*(1-q)*log2(2^(ws)*q). For any Boolean core g on m declared bits with q=P(g=-1)>0 and r>=1 fresh point controls p=2^-r, F=1+A_r(g-1) has v=4*p*q*(1-p*q),I(F)=p*(I(g)+2*r*q), and full-cell C_lab=v*log2(2^m*q). For an odd majority core its prime activated DNF has E|F|=2*p-p^2+p*T_m,k=binom(m,(m+1)/2); for activated prime tribes it has E|F|=4*p*q^2*(1-p)+4*p*s*z*(1-z)^s,k=s. At r=ceil(2*log2(m+1)) activated majority label/I diverges as Theta(sqrt(m)) despite I and minority probability tending to zero. Majority and activated majority are single regular gates, removing these formal label and allocation charges. These statements refute uniform payment of this fixed-scale DNF label expression, not FEI or payment by an optimized complete reference. Equal full-cell single-root witnesses with identical rank laws sum to N*2^(-Lambda)*lambda*pi, refunding log2 N at lambda=1/N while retaining selected-run root rarity -log2 pi.
